title: Cross-tenant denial on API, DB, storage, search, jobs, exports, AI
evidence: db tested (17 suites, two-school fixtures; rls-coverage sweeps every public table); api tested (context/gateway/readiness/scim/membership tests; new: gateway.test.ts second-tenant sweep over every authenticated route, refuses to pass when a route is added unswept); ai tested (intelligence.test.ts another-tenant source refused before the provider); storage partial (community-media only; trust-room bucket untested); search partial (client-side only; listings.check.sql the one server path); jobs partial (worker.test.ts kill switch, no multi-tenant tick); exports partial (deletion.check.sql per-account only); check.sh now runs from check-suites.txt and exits 2 when the list and the files disagree (manifest runner)
gaps: course-room isolation is a per-school switch DEFAULT OFF (tenancy.check.sql:40); no sweep walks every tenant_id/school_id table as a second tenant; no storage bucket policy sweep
blockers: none

title: Sign-in hardening: PKCE S256, verifier before consuming the code, replay and concurrent redemption, exact redirect URIs, host allowlist, audit harness in CI
evidence: PKCE S256 and the exact redirect URI tested for the integrations client (app/src/lib/integration/oauth.test.ts: RFC 7636 appendix B vector, https-only redirect, signed expiring state bound to one tenant and connection, replay of state refused); edge-function origin allowlist with no wildcard (supabase/functions/_shared/cors.ts); LTI launch validated against our own redirect_uri (supabase/functions/_shared/lti.ts:195)
gaps: Semester is the OAuth client, not the authorization server: "validate the verifier before atomically consuming the code" and "concurrent redemption at most one" are the identity provider's properties (Clerk / Supabase Auth) and are not provable from this repository; no nightly audit-harness workflow exists; the 8 AcxLane local OAuth tests named by the plan are not in the repository or either archive
blockers: the interactive prototype (ui_kits/, AcxLane) was not supplied; identity provider is external

title: Role change or consent revocation removes access on every surface
evidence: db tested for role_grants, support_access, family_guardian, advisor_shares, sessions (rolegrants, capabilities, my-capabilities, offboarding-grants, school-offboarding, support-access, support-case-access, family, familyshare, guardian-projection, advisor, share-audit, my-sessions suites); api tested for role_grants (membership.test.ts, pilot-login.test.ts) and family_guardian (family.test.ts); export tested for role_grants (new: gradebook.check.sql, a revoked registrar and an expired instructor are refused at gradebook_export; the red run without the revocation says "was allowed")
gaps: consent_records and course_source_lti partial (evidence-graphs withdrawal hides the capture row; no classmates consent-withdrawal case; LTI membership suspended not deprovisioned); no server-side search exists, so search is untestable rather than tested; no AI-context or realtime post-revocation test; deprovision trigger revokes school-scoped grants only (organization/course/department left open, per 20260930210000 header); a session is proven as a deleted auth.sessions row, never as a refused JWT at the gateway
blockers: none
